method: 240 seeds per policy; 3 profiles × (6 corner policies + R05 baseline) = 5,040 full matches. Same input/seed prefix, normal CROSS, defence INTERCEPT, FAR_POST header, KEEP windows. Real profiles reuse R04B legal GLOBAL_CURRENT elevens; synthetic_readers is an explicitly artificial equal-OVR 80 setup with local DEF/MEN 99 defenders. Once sporting outcomes differ, subsequent main draws need not be counterfactual identical. Corner shots/saves/recoveries exclude the conceding precursor; full-match totals include it.
